data.name: SPLATTER PUNK
data.detailed_description:
Make a mess and do it in style! Skate your way through a monochrome dystopia and deface public property to turn this city into your canvas! Use your mastery of color to paint your way to victory!

Story

In a far-flung dystopian future where big corporations steal color for profit, Axel was once another cog in the machine. After being fired from their job at Chroma Co. they take to the streets with the help of their supplier, Steph. If Axel makes enough of a scene, maybe they can inspire more people to fight back!

Gameplay

Paint is power!

  • Coat the walls and floor in paint to gain bonuses while standing on different colors.

Keep it moving!

  • Dash, grind, and skate quickly between objectives while dodging enemy attacks.

Make a mess and spread the word!

  • Deface propaganda posters and take them down or keep them covered for as long as you can depending on the game mode.

Pick up some new gear!

  • Get decked out in powerful items between levels. Or swap items you don't like for new ones!
